book.modonomicon.demo.features.page_spli: An entry showcasing opt-in page splitting.

This page opts into splitting, so long text flows onto
continuation fragments at full scale instead of shrinking.
The text below is deliberately long: once it overflows the
first fragment, the remainder renders as text-only
continuations with no title or separator.

Splitting is recalculated for the active locale and font,
and links keep working everywhere: [Back to this entry](entry://modonomicon:demo/features/page_splitting)

- Wrapped list lines stay indented under their item.
- Numbered lists behave the same, as shown below.

to find this list continuing without any repeated header.

book.modonomicon.demo.scholarship.name: Scholarship
Actions, research notes, effects and manual completion.
Complete each stage to unlock the next entry. The requirements of the current stage are listed at the bottom of each page.
Click an action icon to perform it. Hover it to see its costs.
Pay 1 paper with the action button.
Hold 2 iron ingots, then press Complete.
Take a blank note, craft it with an ink sac, then use the completed note in the air.
Press the Complete button of the stage line once you hold 2 iron ingots. The ingots are consumed, and you get an emerald.
Craft the blank note with an ink sac. The recipe is in the tab beside this page.
Use the completed note in the air to study it. The note is consumed.
Repeatable action: costs 1 paper and 1 shears durability per note.
